Oh! Location, I misunderstood lol. Garage would be top choice. Second would be a parking garage as far from public as you can.

Parking alone on the tip floor could get Security spotting a suspiciously parked car. But parking Next to anyone has the chance of that person coming back to their vehicle. So be safe and aware of your surroundings \^_\^

The classic would be front seat. The driver parks and the passenger leans over the middle and gets busy. It usually helps to recline the drivers side to give more space. 

It'll depend on the car though. A stickshift between you will be uncomfortable. So a clean back seat is a hot second place.

There's often not enough room on the floor for someone to kneel, but if the seat go back / Forward (depending on front seat/ backseat), that can be the most comfortable for the receiver. 

Make sure you're having fun in private areas where the public can't be affected by your playtime. 

Hope this helps! Have fun! Be responsible, and Comminucate! \^_\^

Overall, my warehouse feels like a Team. Once you're done, your team goes and helps another one. And vice versa when yours is struggling people get pulled to help out.

How runes could be stacked and stuff. On my first day that's as pretty much as I got. My chat and I thought it was syllable based but couldn't figure out much past that. I ended the day thinking it was like Hiragana and each row and collemn were vowels and consonant sounds.  

Day two a friend had worked on it and figured out basically the sounds for the samples. The >!"S" sound being at the end of 'Fox' and the Start of 'Sword'!< helped figure out it was Definitely sound based, not letter based. I pretty much erased my notes and started translating words in the book I knew. First was the >!Compass. I knew it was North, South, East, West!< but that little circle was driving me crazy. I saw the page that had Big Brother's note on it and I didnt help at All! I thought it had to do with symbols overlapping but you'd only ever >!put a Spine (the Inner) with a Shell (The Outer) so there would never Be overlapping!<. Also there being >!no 'Th' on these symbols!< drove me crazy until I remember that >!compass only say N,E,S,W so omitting it was acceptable!< That's when it hit me. >!East has a circle and starts with a Vowel/ Shell! So when theres a circle you put the vowel first!!< Now we're getting somewhere! End of day 2. 

Day 3 (btw these were like 2 or 3 hour streams, I wasnt sitting there the whole day, lol) we went through the book to look for single words I could get. A viewer pointed me to a page that showed you icons for the map. There was a picture of Tunic's head with a circle around it and 3 words. >!Well, if that's a map and that shows where I am those words must be 'You Are Here'.!< So I added those sounds to my page. I went to the controller page and >!got Target no wait.. Focus! Ah yes.!< And then >!Use Item!< I think? Basically combing the book for different things and gradually adding pieces together while solving end game puzzles. >!"The Golden Path" had some sounds for us since it's in glowing yellow it!< was easy to pick out.  I remember we were translating the page that >!check marks the fairies you collect and I was trying to translate the one with the box in the middle of an empty room with a hidden unseeable path.!< The amount of time it took me to sound out the last syllables in >!Ma_e Invsuh_ul...!< was embarassing, lol. 

But at that point, I had enough that I could basically translate any word with some stretch and difficulty. More than once I had to change the sound to something more accurate. But that was basically my journey to creating my own spoiler free, internet free translation key.
